name: doodad-snap-custom-tex
description: Snap Doodads on Load, doodads whose pathing texture is a 4x4 (2x2) file of the map with a pattern of magenta pixels (ring, corner, row, diagonal, half, cross, quadrants; all magenta): the editor turns every picture of more than one colour to the quarter, Studio does the same (fixtures/we-specs/make-doodad-snap.mjs tex)

steps.eval: const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !s.placedObjects()?.doodads?.length; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); window.__driveEd.pushEdit({ undo() {}, redo() {}, terrain: false, objects: false });
